name: Magic Wand Rechargeable
summary: The official cordless successor to the Hitachi Magic Wand: deep, rumbly full-sized head vibration freed from the AC power cord.
ranking_rationale: Nothing beats the genuine Magic Wand motor's low-frequency rumble without numbing buzz; cordless convenience wins most buyers over even against the wired Original.

pricing.notes: Check official Magic Wand site or authorized retailers for current pricing (beware counterfeits on marketplaces).

pros: Authentic deep, low-frequency rumble unmatched by tiny bullet wands
Cordless lithium battery runs up to ~3 hours plus works plugged in
Silicone head and 4 intensity levels + 4 pulse patterns
cons: Loud deep hum and hefty ~1.3 lb frame are impossible to pocket
